mapper.select: select fm.commentId, fm.fileId, fm.spaceId, f.name as fileName, fc.content, u.userName as fromUserName, u.userAvatar as fromUserAvatar, fm.createTime from file_mention fm left join file_comment fc on fm.commentId = fc.id and fc.isDelete = 0 left join file f on fm.fileId = f.id and f.isDelete = 0 left join user u on fm.fromUserId = u.id where fm.toUserId = #{toUserId} and fm.spaceId = #{spaceId} and fc.id is not null and f.id is not null order by fm.createTime desc limit 200
select distinct spaceId from file_mention where toUserId = #{toUserId} and isRead = 0
